problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -2 & 5 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}],\,J=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices above. Given that $A=PJ{P}^{-1}$ is a Jordan canonical decomposition of $A,$ which of the following could be the first column of the matrix $P?$

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,z=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$
